purpose: Evaluate and independently finite-difference verify the exact NL1B2 weakly nonlinear Y-sector memory cross-source DY2[chi10;chi11] using the retained v0.77 native accepted-source traces.

reconstruction.real_space_field: chi_R(x,t)=sum_i sqrt(2 Delta_i P_R(k_i)) chi_i(t) cos(k_i x+phase_i)
reconstruction.primary_chi11: four-lambda mean after the lambda-affinity gate
reconstruction.nonlinear_operator_normalization: O_beta[chi]=(1/(1+beta0))*div_phys(|grad_phys chi| grad_phys chi); the common prefactor 2(2-KB)/a0 is reported separately and not used in numerical conditioning gates

exact_cross_source.formula: DO_beta[chi10;chi11]=(1/(1+beta0))*div_phys[|g| h + (g.h/|g|) g], with g=grad_phys chi10, h=grad_phys chi11 and bracket=0 at |g|=0

descriptive_outputs: L2 norm of baseline Y2 source at each native time
L2 norm of DY2 cross-source at each native time
cosine between Y2 and DY2 at each native time
ratio ||2 DY2||/||2 Y2|| per unit eta tangent
sign of integrated inner product <Y2,DY2> reported descriptively only

classification_rule.pass: all gates pass for every native time and all three beta0 values -> GE03_WEAKLY_NONLINEAR_Y_MEMORY_CROSS_SOURCE_PASS

claim_boundary: PASS certifies the weakly nonlinear Y-memory cross-source entering the exact eta=0 second-order hierarchy. It does not solve Z21, introduce finite eta, simulate nonlinear collapse, or constitute observational evidence.
anti_tuning: Do not change lambdas, modes, phases, redshift window, resolutions, finite-difference steps, beta0 values or gates after inspecting GE03 output.
